17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 507-09 South California Avenue, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: §M1-1 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District
Lot Area: 18,750 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is seeking a zoning change to permit a new four (4) pump
gas station (8 fueling positions) and a one-story accessory retail
convenience store building at the subject property. Off-street parking for
fourteen (14) cars will be provided. The proposed retail convenience store
building will be 25 fi.-8 in. in height and contain 3,840 sq. ft. of total floor
area. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment
and Variation, and Sec. 17-13-1101-T of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
the Applicant is seeking to reduce the minimum lot area for a gas station
from the required 20,000 sq. ft. to 18,750 sq. ft. and is seeking all zoning
relief, as needed and as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the
attached plans.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 3,840 square feet (0.204 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): No dwelling units proposed.

(c) The amount of off-street parking: 14

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 92 feet-4 inches
b. Side Setbacks:
North Side: 2 feet
South Side: 28 feet
c. Rear Setback: 1 feet

(2) Building Height: 25 feet-8 inches
